                 // conservative float bound of Sstar\n    unsigned char* gscratch;       // per-block candidate lists if not in smem\n    int cap;                       // max. neighbourhood size (even)\n    int useShared;\n    int* memScratch;               // per-block member buffer (cap + 1)\n    int* pool;                     // member lists of all evaluated seeds\n    unsigned long long poolCap;\n    unsigned long long* poolTop;\n    long long* seedOff;            // per seed: offset of its list, -1 if none\n};\n\n// One block per seed (persistent loop): grows the candidate cluster of each\n// seed, stores its member list in the pool and reports cardinality/offset.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(B)\nclusterKernel(const KernelArgs args, const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int nSeeds,\n              int* __restrict__ outCard, long long* __restrict__ outOff) {\n    constexpr int NW = B / 32;\n    extern __shared__ __align__(16) unsigned char smem[];\n    __shared__ int warpSums[NW];\n    __shared__ unsigned long long redA[NW];\n    __shared__ int redP[NW];\n    __shared__ int redC[NW];\n    __shared__ int sWin;\n    __shared__ int sAlive;\n    __shared__ long long sOff;\n\n    const double2* __restrict__ pts = args.pts;\n    const float2* __restrict__ ptsf = args.ptsf;\n    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered = args.clustered;\n    const int N = args.N;\n    const int cap = args.cap;\n\n    unsigned char* base = args.useShared\n                              ? smem\n                              : args.gscratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * cap * 20;\n    unsigned long long* maxs = reinterpret_cast<unsigned long long*>(base);\n    float* xf = reinterpret_cast<float*>(maxs + cap);\n    float* yf = xf + cap;\n    int* idx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(yf + cap);\n    int* mbuf = args.memScratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * (cap + 1);\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int wid = tid >> 5;\n    const unsigned long long sBits = static_cast<unsigned long long>(__double_as_longlong(args.Sstar));\n    const float SstarF = args.SstarF;\n\n    for (int w = blockIdx.x; w < nSeeds; w += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[w];\n        const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n        const float2 spf = ptsf[seed];\n\n        // ---- gather unclustered neighbours of the seed, in index order ----\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int b0 = 0; b0 < N; b0 += B) {\n            const int i = b0 + tid;\n            bool f = false;\n            double s = 0.0;\n            float2 q = make_float2(0.f, 0.f);\n            if (i < N && i != seed && !clustered[i]) {\n                q = ptsf[i];\n                if (sqDistF(q.x, q.y, spf.x, spf.y) <= SstarF) {\n                    s = sqDist(pts[i], sp);\n                    f = s < args.Sstar;\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned bal = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, f);\n            if (lane == 0) warpSums[wid] = __popc(bal);\n            __syncthreads();\n            int off = cnt, total = 0;\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int k = 0; k < NW; ++k) {\n                const int v = warpSums[k];\n                if (k < wid) off += v;\n                total += v;\n            }\n            if (f) {\n                const int pos = off + __popc(bal & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n                maxs[pos] = static_cast<unsigned long long>(__double_as_longlong(s));\n                xf[pos] = q.x;\n                yf[pos] = q.y;\n                idx[pos] = i;\n            }\n            cnt += total;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        // ---- greedy growth ----\n        // maxs[j] holds the max over members of the squared distance from\n        // candidate j (stored as raw IEEE bits: for non-negative doubles the\n        // integer order equals the floating point order). Since sqrt is\n        // monotone, sqrt(maxs[j]) is exactly the original max distance; the\n        // argmin compares (sqrt(maxs), position) lexicographically.\n        int size = 1;\n        if (tid == 0) mbuf[0] = seed;\n        int cur = -1;\n        double2 cp = sp;\n        float cxf = 0.f, cyf = 0.f;\n        while (true) {\n            unsigned long long bb = INF_BITS;\n            int bp = NO_POS;\n            int alive = 0;\n            for (int j = tid; j < cnt; j += B) {\n                unsigned long long ab = maxs[j];\n                if (ab >= sBits) continue;\n                if (cur >= 0) {\n                    const float sf = sqDistF(xf[j], yf[j], cxf, cyf);\n                    // float pre-filter with a safe error margin\n                    if (sf > bitsToFloatLower(ab) * (1.0f - 1e-5f) - 1e-4f) {\n                        const unsigned long long db = static_cast<unsigned long long>(\n                            __double_as_longlong(sqDist(pts[idx[j]], cp)));\n                        if (db > ab) {\n                            ab = db;\n                            maxs[j] = ab;\n                            if (ab >= sBits) continue;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                ++alive;\n                combineBest(bb, bp, ab, j);\n            }\n            // block-wide argmin\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n                const unsigned long long ob = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, bb, o);\n                const int op = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, bp, o);\n                combineBest(bb, bp, ob, op);\n            }\n            alive = __reduce_add_sync(0xffffffffu, alive);\n            if (lane == 0) { redA[wid] = bb; redP[wid] = bp; redC[wid] = alive; }\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (wid == 0) {\n                bb = lane < NW ? redA[lane] : INF_BITS;\n                bp = lane < NW ? redP[lane] : NO_POS;\n                alive = __reduce_add_sync(0xffffffffu, lane < NW ? redC[lane] : 0);\n                #pragma unroll\n                for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n                    const unsigned long long ob = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, bb, o);\n                    const int op = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, bp, o);\n                    combineBest(bb, bp, ob, op);\n                }\n                if (lane == 0) {\n                    sWin = bp;\n                    sAlive = alive;\n                    if (bp != NO_POS) {\n                        maxs[bp] = INF_BITS;  // now a member\n                        mbuf[size] = idx[bp];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            const int win = sWin;\n            if (win == NO_POS) break;\n            ++size;\n            cur = win;\n            cp = pts[idx[win]];\n            cxf = xf[win];\n            cyf = yf[win];\n\n            // Ordered in-place compaction of dead entries (keeps index order,\n            // hence identical tie-breaking) once most of the list is dead.\n            if (sAlive * 2 < cnt && cnt >= 2 * B) {\n                int newCnt = 0;\n                for (int b0 = 0; b0 < cnt; b0 += B) {\n                    const int j = b0 + tid;\n                    unsigned long long a = INF_BITS;\n                    float qx = 0.f, qy = 0.f;\n                    int qi = 0;\n                    bool f = false;\n                    if (j < cnt) {\n                        a = maxs[j];\n                        f = a < sBits;\n                        if (f) { qx = xf[j]; qy = yf[j]; qi = idx[j]; }\n                    }\n                    const unsigned bal = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, f);\n                    if (lane == 0) warpSums[wid] = __popc(bal);\n                    __syncthreads();\n                    int off = newCnt, total = 0;\n                    #pragma unroll\n                    for (int k = 0; k < NW; ++k) {\n                        const int v = warpSums[k];\n                        if (k < wid) off += v;\n                        total += v;\n                    }\n                    if (f) {\n                        const int pos = off + __popc(bal & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n                        maxs[pos] = a;\n                        xf[pos] = qx;\n                        yf[pos] = qy;\n                        idx[pos] = qi;\n                    }\n                    newCnt += total;\n                    __syncthreads();\n                }\n                cnt = newCnt;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // ---- store the member list ----\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            long long off = static_cast<long long>(atomicAdd(args.poolTop, static_cast<unsigned long long>(size)));\n            if (static_cast<unsigned long long>(off) + size > args.poolCap) off = -1;  // pool full\n            sOff = off;\n            outCard[w] = size;\n            outOff[w] = off;\n            args.seedOff[seed] = off;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const long long off = sOff;\n        if (off >= 0) {\n            for (int t = tid; t < size; t += B) args.pool[off + t] = mbuf[t];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Number of neighbours (dist < threshold) of each point (excluding itself)\n__global__ void degreeKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n                             const int N, const double Sstar, const float SstarF,\n                             int* __restrict__ deg) {\n    __shared__ float2 tf[256];\n    __shared__ double2 td[256];\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const float2 pf = i < N ? ptsf[i] : make_float2(0.f, 0.f);\n    const double2 pd = i < N ? pts[i] : make_double2(0.0, 0.0);\n    int d = 0;\n    for (int b0 = 0; b0 < N; b0 += 256) {\n        const int j = b0 + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < N) { tf[threadIdx.x] = ptsf[j]; td[threadIdx.x] = pts[j]; }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int lim = min(256, N - b0);\n        if (i < N) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < lim; ++k) {\n                const float2 q = tf[k];\n                if (sqDistF(q.x, q.y, pf.x, pf.y) <= SstarF && b0 + k != i &&\n                    sqDist(td[k], pd) < Sstar) ++d;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (i < N) deg[i] = d;\n}\n\n__global__ void markKernel(const int* __restrict__ members, const int k,\n                           unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < k) clustered[members[t]] = 1;\n}\n\n// One warp per seed: a cached candidate cluster becomes stale iff it contains\n// a (newly) clustered point. Stale seeds are reported and their list dropped.\n__global__ void staleKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                            const int* __restrict__ pool, long long* __restrict__ seedOff,\n                            const int* __restrict__ seedLen,\n                            int* __restrict__ staleOut, int* __restrict__ cntOut) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warpsTotal = gridDim.x * (blockDim.x >> 5);\n    for (int i = blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x >> 5) + (threadIdx.x >> 5); i < N; i += warpsTotal) {\n        if (clustered[i]) continue;\n        const long long off = seedOff[i];\n        if (off < 0) continue;\n        const int len = seedLen[i];\n        bool hit = false;\n        for (int t = lane; t < len && !hit; t += 32) hit = clustered[pool[off + t]] != 0;\n        if (__any_sync(0xffffffffu, hit) && lane == 0) {\n            seedOff[i] = -1;\n            staleOut[atomicAdd(cntOut, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void scatterLenKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n,\n                                 const int* __restrict__ card, int* __restrict__ seedLen) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < n) seedLen[seeds[t]] = card[t];\n}\n\n// Pool compaction: block per live list\n__global__ void compactPoolKernel(const int* __restrict__ src, int* __restrict__ dst,\n                                  const long long* __restrict__ srcOff,\n                                  const long long* __restrict__ dstOff,\n                                  const int* __restrict__ len, const int n) {\n    for (int w = blockIdx.x; w < n; w += gridDim.x) {\n        const long long so = srcOff[w], d = dstOff[w];\n        for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < len[w]; t += blockDim.x) dst[d + t] = src[so + t];\n    }\n}\n\nstruct ClusterLauncher {\n    int blockSize = 128;\n    int memberBlockSize = 1024;\n    int grid = 1;\n    size_t smemBytes = 0;\n    bool useShared = true;\n    int cap = 2;\n\n    // Call f with the compile-time block size\n    template <typename F>\n    static void dispatch(int bs, F&& f) {\n        switch (bs) {\n            case 64:   f(std::integral_constant<int, 64>{}); break;\n            case 128:  f(std::integral_constant<int, 128>{}); break;\n            case 256:  f(std::integral_constant<int, 256>{}); break;\n            case 512:  f(std::integral_constant<int, 512>{}); break;\n            default:   f(std::integral_constant<int, 1024>{}); break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Many seeds: persistent grid of blocks; a single seed: one wide block\n    void run(const KernelArgs& args, const int* seeds, int nSeeds, int* outCard,\n             long long* outOff) const {\n        const bool single = nSeeds == 1;\n        const int g = single ? 1 : std::max(1, std::min(grid, nSeeds));\n        dispatch(single ? memberBlockSize : blockSize, [&](auto bs) {\n            constexpr int B = decltype(bs)::value;\n            clusterKernel<B><<<g, B, useShared ? smemBytes : 0>>>(args, seeds, nSeeds, outCard, outOff);\n        });\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    template <int B>\n    void configureKernel() const {\n        if (useShared && smemBytes > 48 * 1024) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(clusterKernel<B>, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                            static_cast<int>(smemBytes)));\n        }\n    }\n\n    void configure(int numSMs, size_t maxOptinSmem) {\n        const size_t need = static_cast<size_t>(cap) * 20;\n        useShared = need <= maxOptinSmem;\n        smemBytes = useShared ? need : 0;\n        int perSM = 0;\n        dispatch(memberBlockSize, [&](auto bs) { configureKernel<decltype(bs)::value>(); });\n        dispatch(blockSize, [&](auto bs) {\n            constexpr int B = decltype(bs)::value;\n            configureKernel<B>();\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&perSM, clusterKernel<B>, B, smemBytes));\n        });\n        grid = std::max(1, perSM) * numSMs;\n    }\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // sqrt(s) < threshold  <=>  s < Sstar (sqrt is correctly rounded & monotone)\n    double Sstar = threshold * threshold;\n    while (Sstar > 0.0 && std::sqrt(std::nextafter(Sstar, 0.0)) >= threshold)\n        Sstar = std::nextafter(Sstar, 0.0);\n    while (std::sqrt(Sstar) < threshold)\n        Sstar = std::nextafter(Sstar, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n    // Conservative single precision pre-filter bound\n    const float SstarF = std::isinf(Sstar) ? std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity()\n                                           : static_cast<float>(Sstar * (1.0 + 1e-5) + 1e-4);\n\n    std::vector<double2> hp(N);\n    std::vector<float2> hpf(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        hp[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n        hpf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(points[i].x), static_cast<float>(points[i].y));\n    }\n\n    int dev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&dev));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, dev));\n\n    double2* d_pts;\n    float2* d_ptsf;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered;\n    int   CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ptsf, N * sizeof(float2)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, N * CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_stale, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seedLen, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_off, N * sizeof(long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seedOff, N * sizeof(long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_poolTop, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_pts, hp.data(), N * sizeof(double2),    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hdeg.data(), d_deg, N * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    const int maxdeg = *std::max_element(hdeg.begin(), hdeg.end());\n    long long sumDeg = 0;\n    for (int i CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n    unsigned char* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    if (!L.useShared) {\n        // limit global scratch to a reasonable memory budget\n        const size_t std::vector<long long> srcOff, dstOff;\n        std::vector<int> len, who;\n        long long total = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (!hclustered[i] && hvalid[i] && hoff[i] hcard[i];\n            }\n        }\n        unsigned long long newCap = poolCap;\n        if (static_cast<unsigned long long>(total) * 2 > poolCap) {\n            size_t fm = 0, tm = 0;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&fm, &tm));\n            const unsigned long long avail = fm / sizeof(int) * 2 / 3;\n            newCap = std::max<unsigned long long>(poolCap, std::min<unsigned long long>(poolCap * 2, avail));\n        }\n        int* d_newPool;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_newPool, newCap * sizeof(int)));\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(who.size());\n        if (n > 0) {\n            long long *d_src, *d_dst;\n            int* d_len;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_src, n * sizeof(long long)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_dst, n * sizeof(long long)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_len, n * sizeof(int)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_src, srcOff.data(), n * sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_dst, dstOff.data(), n * sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_len, len.data(), n * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_dst));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_len));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_pool));\n        d_pool = d_newPool;\n        poolCap = newCap;\n        args.pool =        // Pool overflow: compact and recompute the seeds without a list\n            compactPool();\n            nb = 0;\n            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)\n                if (!hclustered[i] &&
